text: Global Health Week 2027 set to open in Hanoi
The Global Health Week Vietnam 2027, scheduled for September 15-17, 2027, at the Vietnam Exhibition Center in Hanoi.
A ceremony was held on November 18 to announce the event, which aims to provide a platform for connecting policy, technology and investment across the global healthcare value chain.

Under the theme "Bringing Global Healthcare Excellence Together - Driving Innovation - Shaping the Future of Healthcare", the event is expected to feature more than 500 exhibition booths and attract 30,000 professionals from over 120 countries, alongside 300 international speakers.
The event will comprise three specialised exhibitions held concurrently across six exhibition halls.

Global Health Week Vietnam will showcase medical equipment, robotic surgery, digital healthcare, smart hospitals and medical tourism, while introducing dedicated sections on traditional medicine and rehabilitation, as well as AI and digital transformation in healthcare.
BioPharma Vietnam will focus on pharmaceuticals, pharmaceutical ingredients and medicinal herbs, biologics, vaccines, and cell and gene therapies.
Meanwhile, Laboratory & Diagnostics Vietnam will present laboratory testing solutions, AI-powered medical imaging, molecular diagnostics and laboratory automation technologies.

A highlight will be a series of high-level forums and specialised conferences covering the three exhibition themes, bringing together policymakers, scientists, healthcare professionals and business leaders from Vietnam and abroad.
The program will also feature innovation and technology showcases, as well as PharmaTalk and LabTalk sessions for startups, researchers and developers of emerging technologies.
Business matchmaking and investment sessions will provide opportunities for international investors and companies to connect directly with Vietnamese hospitals, healthcare authorities and businesses.
